verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right with sensible headline/subcopy/CTA steps, but the small white logo sits on a busy green hill crop that has lost the original's sea-and-sky feel, and the Book Now button is jammed against the right edge. B squeezes the image into a sliver, so the oversized logo straddles the image edge and nearly touches the headline; its subcopy is shrunk to tiny, illegible text stranded at the bottom, far from the headline, and its CTA also hugs the right edge.
